desc: RDMA CM communication client test program
r: rdma_xclient - RDMA CM communication client test program
Uses synchronous librdmam calls to establish an RDMA connection between two nodes. This example is intended to provide a very simple coding example of how to use RDMA.

<dl><dt data-o="">-s server_address</dt><dd>Specifies the address of the system that the rdma_server is running on. By default, the client will attempt to connect to the server using 127.0.0.1.</dd><dt data-o="">-p server_port</dt><dd>Specifies the port number that the server listens on. By default the server listens on port 7471.</dd><dt data-o="">-c communication type</dt><dd>Specifies the type of communication established with the server program. 'r' results in using a reliable-connected QP (the default). 'x' uses extended reliable-connected XRC QPs.</dd></dl>

Basic usage is to start rdma_xserver, then connect to the server using the rdma_client program.

Because this test maps RDMA resources to userspace, users must ensure that they have available system resources and permissions. See the libibverbs README file for additional details.
